questions.question: Use sort_bars with order equal to descending and use highlight_top_n with n equal to 2 in order to know What patterns can you observe in product pricing across different customer demographics and product types?

answer.value: Several key patterns emerge: 1) Unknown customer demographics show the highest average price ($56.40), followed by Male ($49.55), Non-binary ($46.50), and Female ($43.52), 2) Cosmetics has the highest average price ($57.36) among product types, significantly higher than skincare ($47.26) and haircare ($46.01), 3) The combination of Male customers and cosmetics products yields the highest average price ($67.24), while Female customers with haircare products have the lowest ($25.54), 4) There is a notable price gap of $12.88 between the highest (Unknown) and lowest (Female) customer demographics, 5) The price variation within each demographic is substantial (standard deviations around $30), indicating diverse pricing strategies or product mixes, 6) Male customers show a strong preference for higher-priced cosmetics, while Female customers tend toward lower-priced haircare products.

key_insights: Unknown demographics have highest average price
Cosmetics is most expensive product type

Highlight top N to emphasize highest values
